sentences.text: Every line you draw gets a label, so you and an examiner can follow your work.
Write the course above the line, with a C, the three-digit direction, and T for true or M for magnetic.
Write the speed below the line with an S.
Mark each position along the track with its symbol, a circle for a fix and a half circle for a dead reckoning position, and write the time beside it, using the twenty-four hour clock.
Here, a boat leaves an eight hundred fix on course zero six eight true at twelve knots, with DR positions at nine and ten hundred.
